summary: Preserve the Writable 'finish' event boundary after all accepted data and finalization are complete.

target.notes: Register via EventEmitter semantics; emit finish after end() and after every chunk plus _final processing completes. Error termination must not incorrectly emit finish.

semantics.event_condition: all writes processed and finalization completed after end
semantics.error_path: finish is not emitted for failed completion

caveats: finish is not equivalent to close; resources may close later.
The end(callback) callback runs before finish.

tests.name: finish after writes
tests.input: const {Writable}=require('node:stream'); const out=[]; const w=new Writable({write(c,e,cb){out.push(c.toString());cb()}}); w.on('finish',()=>console.log(out.join(','))); w.end('x');

tests.name: finish distinct from close
tests.input: const {Writable}=require('node:stream'); const out=[]; const w=new Writable({write(c,e,cb){cb()}}); w.on('finish',()=>out.push('finish')); w.on('close',()=>out.push('close')); w.end(); setImmediate(()=>console.log(out[0]));
tests.expected_behavior: finish occurs as writable completion; close is a separate resource-lifecycle event
